mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scheduled_publications ( id, user_id, draft_id, run_at, timezone, status, idempotency_key, audit_actor, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{draftId}, #{runAt}, #{timezone}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{auditActor}, NOW(3), NOW(3) )
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduled_publications SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_post_id = #{publishedPostId}, published_at = #{publishedAt}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND published_post_id IS NULL

UPDATE scheduled_publications SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE scheduled_publications SET status = 'PROCESSING', version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SCHEDULED'
